senses.en: a person who creates or performs something without preparation
senses.zh: 即兴创作者；即兴表演者

example.en: He is a gifted improviser on the piano.
example.zh: 他是位很有天赋的钢琴即兴演奏者。

senses.en: an exit or the act of going out

example.en: The emergency egress was blocked by boxes.
example.zh: 紧急出口被箱子堵住了。

senses.en: to go out or exit

example.en: Passengers may egress through the rear doors.
example.zh: 乘客可从后门离开。

senses.en: a magnet that works only when electric current flows through it

example.en: The crane uses an electromagnet to lift scrap metal.
example.zh: 这台起重机用电磁铁来吊起废金属。

senses.en: fit to live in; suitable for habitation

example.en: The newly built houses are clean and inhabitable.
example.zh: 新建的房子干净且适合居住。

senses.en: relating to an autobiography or written by someone about their own life

example.en: The novel has autobiographic elements.
example.zh: 这部小说带有自传色彩。

senses.en: the condition of being very overweight, medically unhealthy

example.en: Obesity increases the risk of heart disease.
example.zh: 肥胖会增加患心脏病的风险。

senses.en: relating to or causing sexual desire

example.en: The novel contains some erotic scenes.
example.zh: 这部小说包含一些情色场景。

senses.en: a pause or delay caused by uncertainty or unwillingness

example.en: She agreed to help without hesitation.
example.zh: 她毫不犹豫地答应帮忙。

senses.en: a flat body part that a fish uses for swimming

example.en: The shark's dorsal fin broke the surface of the water.
example.zh: 鲨鱼的背鳍露出水面。

senses.en: a flipper worn for swimming

example.en: Divers wear fins to move through the water more easily.
example.zh: 潜水员穿戴脚蹼以便在水中更轻松地移动。

senses.en: a fashion or interest that is popular for a short time
senses.zh: 一时的风尚；短暂的狂热

example.en: Low-carb diets were just a fad that quickly faded.
example.zh: 低碳饮食只是一阵很快消退的风潮。

senses.en: liking to keep things hidden; not willing to share information
senses.zh: 遮遮掩掩的；守口如瓶的

example.en: He is secretive about his personal life.
example.zh: 他对自己的私生活讳莫如深。

senses.en: the act of starting or creating an organization, system, or arrangement

example.en: The establishment of the committee took several months.
example.zh: 委员会的设立花了几个月时间。

senses.en: an organization or business, especially one with a particular purpose

example.en: She works at a small research establishment.
example.zh: 她在一家小型研究机构工作。

senses.en: the group of powerful people who control a society or an organization

example.en: The plan was criticized by the political establishment.
example.zh: 该计划受到政治当权派的批评。

senses.en: in the same order as the people or things already mentioned

example.en: The teams finished first and second, respectively.
example.zh: 这两支队伍分别获得第一和第二名。

senses.en: something successfully accomplished, especially after effort

example.en: Winning the scholarship was a major achievement.
example.zh: 获得奖学金是一项重大成就。

senses.en: the act of successfully reaching a goal or result

example.en: The achievement of these goals took years of effort.
example.zh: 实现这些目标花了多年努力。

senses.en: the food and drink that a person usually consumes

example.en: A balanced diet includes fruits and vegetables.
example.zh: 均衡的饮食包括水果和蔬菜。

senses.en: a special or restricted eating plan, often for health reasons

example.en: The doctor recommended a special diet before the test.
example.zh: 医生建议在检查前采用特殊饮食。

senses.en: to eat less or follow a special eating plan, especially to lose weight or improve health
senses.zh: 节食；按规定饮食（尤指为减肥或改善健康）

example.en: She has been dieting for several weeks.
example.zh: 她几周来一直在节食。

senses.en: a military unit, smaller than a division

example.en: He served in an artillery regiment for five years.
example.zh: 他在一个炮兵团服役了五年。

senses.en: to organize and control people in a strict, rigid way

example.en: School life there was strictly regimented.
example.zh: 那里的学校生活受到严格管制。

senses.en: a strange or unusual habit or feature

example.en: One peculiarity of his is that he always eats dessert first.
example.zh: 他的一个怪癖是总是先吃甜点。

senses.en: a distinguishing characteristic of a person or thing

example.en: The bird's bright feathers are a peculiarity of the species.
example.zh: 鲜艳的羽毛是这个物种的特有特征。

senses.en: not right or appropriate for a particular purpose, person, or situation

example.en: This dress is unsuitable for cold weather.
example.zh: 这条裙子不适合寒冷的天气。

senses.en: a change in the shape or size of an object caused by stress or force

example.en: Engineers measured the deformation of the bridge under heavy loads.
example.zh: 工程师测量了桥梁在重载下的变形。

senses.en: a disfigured or misshapen part of the body; a physical abnormality

example.en: The X-ray revealed a deformation in the patient's spine.
example.zh: X光片显示患者的脊柱有畸形。

senses.en: an unfriendly or angry feeling toward someone

example.en: He showed open hostility toward his new manager.
example.zh: 他对新经理表现出明显的敌意。

senses.en: fighting or a state of conflict between groups (usually plural)

example.en: The two countries agreed to end hostilities.
example.zh: 两国同意停止敌对行动。

senses.en: a city in Cheshire, northwestern England, known for its Roman walls
senses.zh: 切斯特（英国英格兰柴郡城市）

example.en: Chester is famous for its Roman walls and medieval rows.
example.zh: 切斯特以罗马城墙和中世纪购物廊闻名。

senses.en: a city in southeastern Pennsylvania, USA, near Philadelphia
senses.zh: 切斯特（美国宾夕法尼亚州城市）

example.en: Chester, Pennsylvania, lies on the Delaware River.
example.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州的切斯特位于特拉华河畔。

senses.en: an act of hitting someone repeatedly

example.en: The victim suffered a severe beating.
example.zh: 受害者遭到了严重殴打。

senses.en: a defeat in a game or competition

example.en: Our team took a beating in the final.
example.zh: 我们队决赛中惨败。

senses.en: showing curiosity or concern about something

example.en: She is interested in learning Japanese.
example.zh: 她对学习日语感兴趣。

senses.en: involved in or affected by something, especially financially

example.en: All interested parties were invited to the meeting.
example.zh: 所有有利害关系的各方都被邀请参加会议。

senses.en: relating to a congress, especially the United States Congress
senses.zh: 国会的（尤指美国国会的）

example.en: The proposal was discussed at a congressional hearing.
example.zh: 该提案在一次国会听证会上进行了讨论。

senses.en: an area where explosive mines have been placed

example.en: The soldiers advanced carefully through the minefield.
example.zh: 士兵们小心翼翼地穿过雷区。

senses.en: a situation full of hidden dangers or difficulties

example.en: Negotiating salaries can be a minefield for new employees.
example.zh: 对新手来说，谈薪水可能是一个布满陷阱的领域。

senses.en: impossible to calm or satisfy; not forgiving
senses.zh: 难以平息的；不肯和解的

example.en: He faced implacable opposition from his rivals.
example.zh: 他面临对手毫不妥协的反对。

senses.en: to introduce new ideas or methods

example.en: The company must innovate to stay competitive.
example.zh: 公司必须创新才能保持竞争力。

senses.en: having an attractive, well-proportioned shape

example.en: The garden featured shapely hedges along the path.
example.zh: 花园小径两旁是修剪得匀称美观的树篱。

senses.en: an ornament or badge shaped like a rose, often worn to show rank or an award
senses.zh: 玫瑰花饰；（缎带做的）玫瑰花形徽章

example.en: The winner wore a red rosette on her jacket.
example.zh: 获胜者外套上别着一枚红色玫瑰花徽章。

senses.en: courage; the quality of facing danger or pain without fear

example.en: The firefighter was awarded a medal for her bravery.
example.zh: 这位消防员因勇敢而被授予勋章。

senses.en: to make something modern, or to adopt modern methods

example.en: The company plans to modernise its old factories.
example.zh: 公司计划使其旧工厂现代化。

senses.en: impossible to get through or enter
senses.zh: 无法穿过的；不可进入的

example.en: The jungle was almost impenetrable.
example.zh: 那片丛林几乎无法穿行。

senses.en: impossible to understand

example.en: The report was written in impenetrable jargon.
example.zh: 这份报告用语晦涩难懂。

senses.en: a state of pleasant daydreaming

example.en: She was lost in a reverie, staring out the window.
example.zh: 她凝视着窗外，沉浸在幻想中。

senses.en: not including something

example.en: The trip costs $500, excluding flights.
example.zh: 这次旅行花费500美元，不含机票。

senses.en: shockingly unacceptable or disgraceful

example.en: It's scandalous that patients have to wait so long for treatment.
example.zh: 病人要等这么久才能得到治疗，真是可耻。

senses.en: damaging to someone's reputation; defamatory

example.en: He filed a lawsuit over the scandalous article.
example.zh: 他就那篇诽谤性的文章提起了诉讼。

senses.en: to go or come after someone or something

example.en: The dog followed me home.
example.zh: 那只狗跟着我回了家。

senses.en: to do what a rule, instruction, or person says

example.en: Please follow the safety rules.
example.zh: 请遵守安全规则。

senses.en: to understand what someone says or what happens

example.en: I couldn't follow his explanation.
example.zh: 我没听懂他的解释。

senses.en: an act of choosing to see someone's posts on social media

example.en: She gained a thousand new follows last week.
example.zh: 她上周新增了一千个关注。

senses.en: to do something with an object or tool for a purpose

example.en: She uses a bike to get to work.
example.zh: 她骑自行车上班。

senses.en: the act or purpose of using something

example.en: The use of robots in farming is growing.
example.zh: 机器人在农业中的使用正在增加。

senses.en: to take or consume something, especially fuel or energy

example.en: This old heater uses too much electricity.
example.zh: 这台旧取暖器耗电太多。

senses.en: benefit or value from something

example.en: There is no use in arguing.
example.zh: 争论没有用处。

senses.en: a very young child or infant

example.en: The baby slept peacefully in her crib.
example.zh: 婴儿在她的婴儿床里安静地睡着了。

senses.en: the youngest member of a family or group
senses.zh: 家中或团体中最年幼的人

example.en: She is the baby of the family.
example.zh: 她是家里最小的孩子。

senses.en: small or young version of something

example.en: A baby grand piano stood in the corner.
example.zh: 角落里放着一架小型三角钢琴。

senses.en: to treat someone like a baby; to pamper
senses.zh: 娇惯；像对待婴儿一样对待

example.en: Don't baby him; he needs to learn on his own.
example.zh: 别娇惯他；他需要自己学会。

senses.en: the flat surface you walk on inside a room

example.en: The keys fell on the kitchen floor.
example.zh: 钥匙掉在厨房地板上。

senses.en: one level of a building

example.en: Her office is on the third floor.
example.zh: 她的办公室在三楼。

senses.en: to knock someone down

example.en: The boxer floored his opponent in the second round.
example.zh: 拳击手在第二回合击倒了对手。

senses.en: to surprise or confuse someone completely

example.en: The question completely floored me.
example.zh: 这个问题完全把我问住了。

senses.en: a person who helps someone with work or tasks

example.en: The professor's assistant returned the marked papers.
example.zh: 教授的助理发回了批改过的论文。

senses.en: having a secondary role and helping someone more senior

example.en: She was promoted from assistant manager to store manager.
example.zh: 她从助理经理升职为店长。

senses.en: a device or program that helps users perform tasks

example.en: I asked the voice assistant to set a reminder for ten minutes.
example.zh: 我让语音助手设置一个十分钟后的提醒。

senses.en: a set of items written or printed one after another

example.en: Please add milk to the shopping list.
example.zh: 请把牛奶加到购物清单上。

senses.en: to write or say items one after another

example.en: She listed the reasons for her decision.
example.zh: 她列出了自己做出这个决定的理由。

senses.en: to live in a place; occupy as a home

example.en: Many rare birds inhabit this island.
example.zh: 许多珍稀鸟类栖息在这座岛上。

senses.en: moving or happening very fast

example.en: The swift current carried the boat downstream.
example.zh: 湍急的水流把小船冲向下游。

senses.en: quickly, at high speed

example.en: The arrow flew swift and true.
example.zh: 箭飞得又快又准。

senses.en: a fast-flying bird with long narrow wings
senses.zh: 雨燕（一种飞行速度很快的鸟）

example.en: Swifts circle high above the rooftops in summer.
example.zh: 夏天，雨燕在屋顶上方盘旋。

senses.en: a small torn or old piece of cloth

example.en: She wiped the table with an old rag.
example.zh: 她用一块旧抹布擦了桌子。

senses.en: to tease or make fun of someone in a playful way

example.en: His friends ragged him about his new haircut.
example.zh: 他的朋友戏弄他新剪的发型。

senses.en: a newspaper, especially one regarded as low quality (informal)

example.en: He writes for a local rag.
example.zh: 他给一份地方小报写稿。

senses.en: to change from liquid into vapor; to dry up

example.en: The water in the pan evaporated quickly in the heat.
example.zh: 锅里的水在高温下很快蒸发了。

senses.en: to disappear gradually, especially of feelings or hopes

example.en: Her confidence seemed to evaporate after the failed interview.
example.zh: 那次面试失败后，她的信心似乎消散了。

senses.en: a spoken or written request asking someone to attend or take part in something

example.en: She sent me an invitation to her wedding.
example.zh: 她给我发了婚礼请柬。

senses.en: something that tempts or attracts someone

example.en: An unlocked car is an invitation to thieves.
example.zh: 不上锁的汽车容易招来小偷。

senses.en: the way a person pronounces words, showing where they come from

example.en: She speaks English with a French accent.
example.zh: 她说英语带法语口音。

senses.en: the stress placed on a particular syllable of a word

example.en: In the word "banana", the accent falls on the second syllable.
example.zh: 在 banana 这个词中，重音落在第二个音节上。

senses.en: to emphasize or stress a word or part of something

example.en: The designer accented the room with bright colors.
example.zh: 设计师用明亮的颜色来突出这个房间。

senses.en: approaching death; about to die

example.en: She stayed at the bedside of her dying father.
example.zh: 她守在垂危的父亲床边。

senses.en: gradually coming to an end or disappearing
senses.zh: 逐渐消亡的；即将结束的

example.en: He tried to save the dying tradition of hand weaving.
example.zh: 他努力挽救日渐消亡的手工编织传统。

senses.en: used for emphasis, meaning very eager (informal)
senses.zh: 极度渴望的（口语，用于强调）

example.en: I'm dying to see the new movie.
example.zh: 我特别想看这部新电影。

senses.en: the process or moment of coming to the end of life

example.en: Doctors learn how to comfort patients in their dying.
example.zh: 医生学习如何安慰临终的病人。

senses.en: a knitted garment worn on the upper body to keep warm

example.en: She wore a warm sweater on the cold morning.
example.zh: 寒冷的早晨她穿着一件暖和的毛衣。

senses.en: to begin something again or extend it for a further period

example.en: I need to renew my passport before the trip.
example.zh: 旅行前我需要续签护照。

senses.en: to restore something to its original or better condition

example.en: The city renewed the old bridge last year.
example.zh: 市政府去年翻新了那座旧桥。

senses.en: a mixture used to bind bricks or stones, often made from sand, water, and cement or lime

example.en: The workers mixed mortar to lay the bricks.
example.zh: 工人们搅拌砂浆来砌砖。

senses.en: a short-barreled gun that fires shells at high angles over short ranges

example.en: The soldiers fired a mortar at the enemy position.
example.zh: 士兵们用迫击炮向敌方阵地开火。

senses.en: a bowl-shaped container in which substances are crushed with a pestle

example.en: She ground the garlic in a mortar.
example.zh: 她用研钵把大蒜捣碎。

senses.en: to plaster or join something with mortar

example.en: They mortared the gaps between the stones.
example.zh: 他们用砂浆填补石块之间的缝隙。

senses.en: the medical field that treats mental disorders

example.en: She decided to specialize in child and adolescent psychiatry.
example.zh: 她决定专攻儿童与青少年精神病学。

senses.en: having sharp angles or corners; not rounded

example.en: The building has an angular design.
example.zh: 这座建筑的设计棱角分明。

senses.en: relating to angles or measured in angles

example.en: Angular velocity measures how fast an object rotates.
example.zh: 角速度测量物体旋转的快慢。

senses.en: a large, disorderly crowd of people

example.en: Hordes of tourists visit the castle every summer.
example.zh: 每年夏天大批游客参观这座城堡。

senses.en: happening irregularly, with sudden stops and starts
senses.zh: 断断续续的；一阵一阵的

example.en: He slept a few hours in a fitful doze.
example.zh: 他断断续续地打盹睡了几个小时。

senses.en: the wife of a duke, or a woman with a duchy title in her own right

example.en: The duchess attended the charity gala in the city.
example.zh: 公爵夫人出席了在市里举行的慈善晚会。

senses.en: to lower the quality or value of something; to make someone lose dignity
senses.zh: 降低（品质或价值）；贬低；使丧失尊严

example.en: Critics said the show debased the value of real art.
example.zh: 批评者说这个节目贬低了真正艺术的价值。

senses.en: extremely evil or wicked

example.en: The villainous character plotted to steal the treasure.
example.zh: 那个邪恶的角色密谋偷走宝藏。

senses.en: (offensive) an unsophisticated person from a rural or mountainous area

example.en: He was unfairly labeled a hillbilly because of his accent.
example.zh: 因为口音，他不公平地被贴上了乡巴佬的标签。

senses.en: happening or existing at the same time

example.en: He is serving two concurrent prison sentences.
example.zh: 他正在同时服两个刑期。

senses.en: to make something, especially food or drink, by mixing ingredients

example.en: She concocted a new soup from leftover vegetables.
example.zh: 她用剩下的蔬菜调制了一种新汤。

senses.en: to invent a story or plan, often a false one

example.en: He concocted an excuse to skip the meeting.
example.zh: 他编造了一个缺席会议的借口。

senses.en: in agreement or matching; corresponding

example.en: Her actions were congruent with her stated beliefs.
example.zh: 她的行为与她宣称的信念一致。

senses.en: (geometry) having exactly the same shape and size

example.en: The two triangles are congruent, so their sides are equal.
example.zh: 这两个三角形全等，所以它们的边相等。

senses.en: designed to resist damage from shocks or impacts

example.en: This shockproof watch is ideal for outdoor work.
example.zh: 这款防震手表非常适合户外工作。
